notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/5e72f6b9e7b00fedb115b1dc1a62ebb27f7e97f6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Happy Birthday, Billy! We miss you ♂ [/h2]

[h2]Today could have been the [b]53rd [/b]birthday of the legendary Aniki.[/h2]

[h3]"[i]I want to tell my fans to live their life without any judgements and be adventurous. When opportunity comes, put work into your faith and don't be afraid to go out and live life. notes.title: Rest in Peace Aniki ♂
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/cc7dac9ccfc883ff84b231b4c660ca9b8a10a774.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Billy Herrington[/b], the [b]inspiration[/b] for so many of us, has been gone for [b]four years[/b], but we will continue [b]to honor[/b] and [b]respect[/b] his memory. Billy will remain [b]forever in our hearts[/b].[/h3]
[h2]
Give yourself a hard workout that day, Billy would love that.[/h2]

[previewyoutube=zIl39HdaXD0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]
"[i]I don’t see you all as fans, rather I embrace you all like friends. We’re all stars.[/i]"

"[i]I want to tell my fans to live their life without any judgements and be adventurous. When opportunity comes, put work into your faith and don't be afraid to go out and live life. Whatever your sexuality is, gay, straight, boy, girl, go have fun. That's what life is all about. And live a life of yugaminee.[/i]"


[b][i] (c)[/i] Billy [i]Herrington[/i][/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/113f363788d05359e510772c247fe2fac4553a6c.jpg[/img]

[h3]He will be waiting for us in the Heaven's Gym (annual membership is $300)[/h3]

[previewyoutube=cqVcSywVzLk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Free DLC Patch to get All Content
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/1118f31e8cb17fde914fd4b32bd15bcc4b72c3b2.png[/img]

[h3]Friends, in order to access all game content, you need to install the FREE DLC Patch. To do this, follow the instructions:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/7b0eef5de40e80b5fb1700a634d66631b1b0540d.gif[/img]

1. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293240/House_of_Detention__Adult_18_Patch_FREE/]Go to the patch page (you must be logged in to see 18+ content) - [/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293240/House_of_Detention__Adult_18_Patch_FREE/]link[/url]

2. Add it to your library, download and install

3. Go to the House of Detention page in your Steam Library, click on “Manage My DLC”  and enable the patch - check the box next to it and click “OK”

4. Launch the game, if in the upper right corner you see the choice of the type of monsters - then everything went well![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/482c2da58028eafcc244a2e70d078eca32470cf3.gif[/img]
